items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was one of Pola Negri’s gowns.

ctx.x: Did you have to wear anything different that you would in your normal stage appearance?
No, I wore a gown. I think it was one of Pola Negri’s gowns. And I had my hair in an upsweep and a gardenia on the right-hand side.
Was it simply a musical part or did you have spoken lines?
